name: Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement
description: Standard terms for a mutual NDA allowing both parties to share confidential information for a defined purpose, with equal obligations for each party as both discloser and receiver.

name: Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement Cover Page
description: Cover page template for the Common Paper Mutual NDA, containing the key variables such as purpose, effective date, MNDA term, term of confidentiality, governing law, and signature blocks.

name: Cloud Service Agreement
description: Comprehensive agreement governing the provision of cloud-based software services, covering access and use rights, restrictions, privacy, payment, term and termination, warranties, liability, indemnification, and confidentiality between a provider and customer.

name: Design Partner Agreement
description: Agreement for early-access design partner programs where a partner gains access to a product in exchange for providing feedback, with the provider retaining all intellectual property developed from the program.

name: Service Level Agreement
description: Standard terms defining target uptime and response time commitments for cloud services, including how availability is calculated, service credits for failures, and the process for requesting remedies.

name: Professional Services Agreement
description: Agreement governing the provision of professional services including deliverables, intellectual property ownership, payment, confidentiality, indemnification, and insurance requirements between a service provider and customer.

name: Data Processing Agreement
description: Agreement governing the processing of personal data by a provider on behalf of a customer, covering GDPR and UK GDPR compliance, data subject rights, subprocessors, international data transfers, security incident response, and audit rights.

name: Software License Agreement
description: Agreement for licensing on-premise or installable software, covering license grant, restrictions, updates, payment, warranties, liability limitations, indemnification, and confidentiality between a software provider and customer.

name: Partnership Agreement
description: Agreement establishing a commercial partnership between two companies, covering mutual obligations, trademark licensing, payment, escalation procedures, confidentiality, indemnification, and liability.

name: Pilot Agreement
description: Short-form agreement for a time-limited product pilot or proof-of-concept, giving a customer temporary access to evaluate the product for potential purchase, with minimal warranties and a simple liability cap.

name: Business Associate Agreement
description: HIPAA-compliant agreement governing how a business associate (provider) handles Protected Health Information on behalf of a covered entity (company), including safeguards, breach notification, subcontractors, and individual rights obligations.

name: AI Addendum
description: Addendum to a base software or cloud service agreement covering AI-specific terms including permitted use of AI services, restrictions on AI-assisted decision-making, model training rights, IP ownership of inputs and outputs, and AI disclaimers.
